name: Amelia and the Erotic Tentacle Trap Dungeon
detailed_description:
Overview

This adult RPG blends roguelike dungeon exploration with deep character progression.

You play as the witch Amelia, exploring a world full of danger and discovery while facing both internal and external challenges.

You can freely shape her development path and choose how to react to events, crafting your own unique adventure.

Will she maintain her original path, or will she explore new possibilities and aspects of herself? Her destiny is in your hands.

Story

In the outskirts of the prosperous holy city of Crescent, rumors tell of a dungeon from which no investigator has ever returned.

To uncover the truth, the powerful adventurer Amelia accepts the mission.

During her exploration, she encounters strange magical phenomena that challenge her perceptions and lead her to discover new sides of her own desires.

As she travels between the dungeon and the town, Amelia faces unforeseen events and must make pivotal choices.

Characters

※Amelia

A calm and decisive witch, skilled in ranged magic and strategic thinking.

She is the only character who appears in H-scenes. All of her character states and progression paths are determined by player choice.

Roguelike Dungeon

The dungeon features roguelike random generation, offering new layouts, traps, and enemies with each run.

  • Use ranged magic and items to handle any surprises.

  • Special effects or battle responses may trigger based on Amelia's current character state.

  • Trap events can be avoided or confronted—the player controls all trigger conditions.

  • Unlocking unique character states reveals richer interactions and story moments during exploration.

Town & Systems

In town, players can:

  • Buy powerful staves and items.

  • Take on part-time jobs to boost stats or earn money.

  • Trigger special events based on costumes (maid, dancer, bunny girl, bikini, etc.).

  • Observe how NPC reactions change based on her outfit or reputation.

As Amelia's character path evolves through your choices, new town events will unfold, enhancing the adventure.

H Content

  • The game features a variety of adult scenes that branch based on player choices and Amelia's resulting character state.

  • All scenes are designed around consensual interaction and strategic choices, supporting different playstyles.

  • Five unique endings offer significant replayability and route diversity.

*All in-game content is uncensored.*
